notes.title: UPDATE!
notes.notes:
[p]This was my first update ever! [/p][p]Initially, I thought I would just release this game, and never update it.  [/p][p]I missed the days when you bought a video game, and it just was how it was.  
I wanted to challenge myself and improve the game though![/p][p]-Changed mission 1  [/p][p]-Configured finishing missions to flow to the next mission. [/p][p]-A couple of missions have some hidden data to scrape or packages to scan  

Thanks for the support! 
Hope you enjoy getting the Choppers![/p]
